name: Asanoha
description: Asanoha, the hemp leaf: six spokes from a point, repeated until the whole cloth is stars.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 53.5% 43.9%, 93.3% 25.0%, 57.0% 50.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 53.5% 56.1%, 50.0% 100.0%, 46.5% 56.1%, 6.7% 75.0%, 43.0% 50.0%, 6.7% 25.0%, 46.5% 43.9%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 53.5% 43.9%, 93.3% 25.0%, 57.0% 50.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 53.5% 56.1%, 50.0% 100.0%, 46.5% 56.1%, 6.7% 75.0%, 43.0% 50.0%, 6.7% 25.0%, 46.5% 43.9%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 93.3% 25.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 6.7% 75.0%, 6.7% 25.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 93.3% 25.0%, 93.3% 75.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 6.7% 75.0%, 6.7% 25.0%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 88%, #000 88%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 88%, #000 88%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
